content.title: Luke Combs’ 2026 Allegiant Stadium Show in Las Vegas, Nevada: Everything You Need to Know | Holler
content.text: March 20, 2026 4:30 pm GMT LUKE COMBS 2026 TOUR - LAS VEGAS, NEVADAWhen: Saturday, March 21st, 2026Where: Allegiant StadiumWho are the Openers: Dierks Bentley, Ty Myers and Thelma & JamesWhat is Luke Combs Expected to Perform: Taken from Luke Combs’ set at Georgia Theatre in Athens, Georgia on October 17th, 20251, 2 ManyWhen It Rains It PoursCold as YouHouston, We Got a ProblemOne Number AwayGoing, Going, GoneWhere the Wild Things AreBetter TogetherForever After AllBeautiful CrazyOrdinary (Alex Warren cover)Backup PlanBack in the SaddleLovin’ on YouShe Got the Best of MeHurricaneThe Kind Of Love We MakeBeer Never Broke My HeartEncoreFast CarAin't No Love in OklahomaWhen Do Parking Lots Open: 4mWhen Do Doors Open: 5pmWhen Does the First Opener Perform: 5:50pmWhat Time Does Luke Take the Stage: Usually around 9pmWhere Can I Buy Tickets: Luke Combs 2026 Tickets Hot on the heels of Luke Combs’ brand new album, The Way I Am, being released, the North Carolina native's My Kinda Saturday Night World Tour is finally kicking off. Combs begins his continent-spanning trek with an eagerly anticipated show at Las Vegas’ Allegiant Stadium on Saturday, March 21st 2026. The roster of opening acts throughout the ‘Beer Never Broke My Heart’ hitmaker's tour is incredibly impressive, and his first night in Nevada epitomises this, with Dierks Bentley, Ty Myers and Thelma & James supporting Combs. Given this stacked line-up, it'll take on the feel of being more like a mini country festival, rather than a headline show. Doors open at 5pm, with the first act - Thelma & James - expected to take the stage shortly after at 5:50pm. Combs tends to start his set at around 9pm, finishing at roughly 11pm - but as always, all of the evening's set times are subject to change. There's a strict bag policy in place, which you can check out in full HERE. As for merchandise, with this being the first show on his 2026 tour, we're excited to see what new items Combs has on offer. We suspect there will be a host of sleek, must-have pieces themed around the ‘Beautiful Crazy’ crooner's latest album, The Way I Am. Similarly, Combs’ 2026 setlist remains something of an unknown - so don't take the sample setlist as Gospel. He'll surely keep all his biggest hits in there, such as ’Beer Never Broke My Heart’, ‘Fast Car’, ‘Beautiful Crazy’, ‘She Got the Best Of Me’, ‘When It Rains It Pours’, ‘Hurricane’, ‘Lovin’ On You’ and ’Where the Wild Things Are’. Another song we can say with almost certainty - although you never know - that Combs will perform is his rowdy earworm, ‘My Kinda Saturday Night’, as it inspired the tour's name. We hope he introduces a host of early fan-favourites from The Way I Am in there too, such as ’Daytona 499’, ‘Rethink Some Things’, ‘Wish Upon a Whiskey’ and ‘Be By You’. One thing is for sure - Combs will put on an electrifying show, with the country titan renowned for his varied, high-energy sets that combine his penchant for soulful, heartfelt ballads with his ability to deliver a soaring, galvanising barroom soundtrack.
